title: Upward Growth Scratchpad — 1to1 prep (Sahana → Eli)
agenda_items: 5m quick wins + highlights (what went well since last 1:1)
10m career trajectory: concrete next steps toward L4 (skills + signals)
10m blockers: infra flakiness, CI timeouts, cross-team alignment
5m on-call load and adjustments (current fatigue + coverage)
5m pairing/shadow plan with SRE for production debugging skill-up
5m experiment: perf-regression triage rule and rollback cadence
5m wrap: action items, timing, and how I’ll support
action_items: Eli: run flaky-test triage today, annotate failures with --sig=flaky and link to JIRA-ENG-2841; target: 2026-03-10
Sahana: draft promotion-readiness checklist tailored to Eli (examples of impact metrics + recommended projects); target: 2026-03-12
Eli + Lina: schedule two 90m shadow sessions with SRE on prod-debug flow — first by 2026-03-18
Eli: pick one recent PR for a coaching deep-dive next week (I'll join the review); target: 2026-03-09
Sahana: unblock cross-team meetings with infra-ops owner (Arjun) and confirm weekly sync; target: 2026-03-08
Eli: prepare 2 slide examples of measurable impact (latency reduction or cost saving) for promotion packet; target: 2026-03-20
content:
Context: Eli has strong ownership on inference batching work; looking to coach toward broader system-level impact and promotion readiness. Want to be concrete: not just "be more product-minded" but list actionable signals (customers impacted, % latency down, cost/unit improvements, runbook authored).

Notes to self (choppy):
- Start with 1-2 wins to build confidence: recent batching PR + improved p99 for low-latency path. Call out numbers if possible.
- Ask: Which work felt most ambiguous vs where they had clear impact?
- Promotion signals to discuss (translate to examples):
  * Technical depth: owned cross-service design (show design doc link)
  * Impact: reduced tail latency by X%, or reduced token cost by $Y on sample workload
  * Leadership: mentored 2 engineers, ran postmortem and changed rollout policy
  * Scope: led work that required cross-stack coordination (infra + model-onboarding)
- Resources: point to Confluence career-ladders page, give template for packet.

Blockers (current):
- Flaky CI tests -> slows iteration and blocks demos. (JIRA-ENG-2841). Hypothesis: test infra timeouts + race in kv-cache tests.
- Cross-team sync with infra-ops stalled; need Arjun to agree on quick triage loop.
- On-call fatigue: Eli has had 3 pagers in last 2 weeks, wants to reduce on-call load or rotate more fairly.

Suggested manager prompts (phrasing):
- "Tell me one project you’re proud of since our last 1:1 and why — what did you change that others couldn't?"
- "If you were writing your promotion packet today, which three artifacts would you include?"
- "What’s the single thing I can remove from your plate this sprint to create headroom for higher-impact work?"

Coaching notes (private):
- Push Eli to quantify impact. If they struggle, pair to pull metrics in session.
- Encourage documentation of runbooks / postmortem style notes — small wins compound.
- Role-play quick answers to "why you deserve the promotion" (prep 1-2 minute elevator pitch).

Follow-up cadence:
- Quick sync next week for PR deep-dive (30m). Confirm via Slack after this 1:1.
- Check promotion checklist draft by 2026-03-12.
- Re-evaluate on-call rotation with Arjun in 2 weeks.

Open questions to close in meeting:
- Does Eli prefer lowering on-call frequency or increasing shadow handoff?
- Which perf metric is easiest to pull for the promotion packet? (Productized latency views vs infra traces)
- Are there low-visibility wins that we can call out as impact? (e.g., reduced cost for nightly pipelines)

Tone notes: keep it collaborative and concrete, not vague. Use examples, numbers, and artifacts.

Quick checklist before meeting:
- Pull p99/p95 numbers for inference-batching from observability dashboard (link in Slack)
- Open PR (#789) and pick one line of feedback to discuss in person
- Share promotion checklist draft in meeting for live edits

End.
summary: Prep doc for a focused, action-oriented 1:1 — align on promotion signals, remove blockers (CI + on-call), and schedule SRE shadowing. Emphasis: quantify impact and create artifacts for packet.
